ui.siteSubtitle: A friendly, honest quiz 💛 There are no trick questions — just be yourself!
ui.introBody: To give you a good evaluation, please answer all questions as honestly as you can. 🌼 If any question makes you feel uncomfortable, you can always choose “I don’t feel comfortable answering this”. 🤍 There are no right or wrong answers — just answer truthfully! ✨
ui.friendNote: Looking only for friendship? 🤝 This page is for romantic connection. Our friends page is in beta — you can send a friend request there instead! 💛
ui.skip: I don't feel comfortable answering this 🤍
ui.sectionGateTitle: Thank you for sharing so openly 💛
ui.sectionGateBody: We don't seem to be a match at this time. 🌷 We truly wish you all the best on your journey! ✨
ui.resultHighBody: You have a lovely pairing score! If you'd like, you can leave a message below. 💌
ui.resultLowTitle: 🌷 Thank you for completing the journey! 🌷
ui.resultLowBody: You still have a chance! 🍀 Life is full of surprises. If you'd like, feel free to send an invite with your result!
ui.gdprNotice: Privacy notice (GDPR): by sending, you agree that your answers and any file you attach will be emailed to the site owner and stored in their mailbox. You can request deletion at any time. Please only send what you are comfortable sharing.
ui.messagePlaceholder: Write your message here (up to 1000 words) 💭
ui.includeAnswers: Include all my quiz answers with the message (recommended) 📋
ui.attachLabel: Attach a file if you like (PDF only, up to 25MB) 📎
